label: Thursday evening, the short walk across the moor to the hollow
quote: A short walk across the moor took us to the hollow in which the body had been found
note: Holmes follows the Inspector outside from Straker's house.

label: Thursday evening, at the hollow where the body was found
quote: At the brink of it was the furze-bush upon which the coat had been hung
note: Talk of the wind, the coat and the matting. Holmes studies the mud, finds the vesta and compares the boots (¶94–108). The Colonel looks at his watch and asks about the entries (¶110–112).

label: When the overcoat was laid across the furze-bush
quote: Yes, it was laid across the bush
note: This is on the night of the crime, when there was no wind but very heavy rain (¶94–95). It comes before the coat was seen from the knoll (¶35), but the text does not order it against the struggle.

label: When the half-burned wax vesta came into the mud of the hollow
quote: It was a wax vesta half burned
note: The text does not date it. It was buried in the mud and overlooked until Holmes looked for it.

label: When Silver Blaze cast the horseshoe in the Inspector's bag
quote: a cast horseshoe of Silver Blaze
note: The text does not date it.

label: Since Monday night, the feet trampling the ground at the hollow
quote: No doubt many feet have been here since Monday night
note: This is when the matting was laid at the side and stood upon (¶99). It comes before Holmes arrives at the hollow.

label: When the Inspector examined the ground a hundred yards round the hollow
quote: I have examined the ground very carefully for a hundred yards in each direction
note: This was before Holmes arrived. The boot, the shoe and the horseshoe went into the Inspector's bag at some time before this scene (¶101).

label: Thursday evening, before dark, Holmes's walk over the moor
quote: I should like to take a little walk over the moor before it grows dark

label: Thursday evening, the Colonel and the Inspector back at Straker's house
quote: You will find us at poor Straker's house when you have finished your walk
note: The Colonel asks the Inspector to come back with him (¶110).

label: Thursday evening, the drive together into Tavistock
quote: we can drive together into Tavistock
note: This is planned. It comes after Holmes's walk.

label: The next day, when Holmes means to know his ground
quote: that I may know my ground to-morrow
note: This is the same day as the inquest (¶73), but the text does not order the two.
